def operating(mo,load):
 dT=20.;p=mo.P*load;npan=mo.npan0;ncol=max(1,round(npan/10));area=mo.A0
 c,pump,mod=M.cool2(p,area,npan,ncol,dT,2)
 Q=(p*1000+2000+pump)/.92;rad_dT=dT*Q/(p*1000)
 k=M.DEFAULTS;F=mo.Fe*k['yoke_Feff_scale']*(k['coat_F0']/.99);ee,sink,beta=M._ee_Ts(k['eps0'],F,k['alpha_eol'],k['qscale'])
 root=M.supply_for_area(Q,area/FV.AREA_FACTOR,k['eps0'],F,k['alpha_eol'],k['qscale'],rad_dT,FIN_TAB)
 supply=root+.44;ref=supply+dT/2;gpu=ref+1.7*load*14.22;hbm=ref+18*load
 return dict(load_fraction=load,IT_kW=p,pump_electric_W=pump,total_solar_power_and_rejected_heat_W=Q,rack_delta_K=dT,radiator_delta_K=rad_dT,coolant_supply_K=supply,coolant_rack_mean_K=ref,coolant_rack_return_K=supply+dT,coolant_radiator_inlet_K=supply+rad_dT,GPU_K=gpu,HBM_K=hbm,all_modeled_coolant_colder_than_both_chips=supply+rad_dT<min(gpu,hbm),rho_kg_m3=M.CT.G['rho'],cp_J_kgK=M.CT.G['cp'],mass_flow_kg_s=p*1000/(M.CT.G['cp']*dT),volume_flow_L_s=p*1000/(M.CT.G['cp']*dT)/M.CT.G['rho']*1000,effective_emissivity=ee,effective_radiation_sink_K=sink,fin_area_factor=FV.AREA_FACTOR,fin_table=FIN_TAB,mc_temperature_margin_K=.44,radiation_root_without_mc_K=root,heat_pickup_location='Rack -> auxiliary/PMAD/pump losses -> radiator -> cold supply. Rack20K rise follows IT, radiator rise follows TOTAL heat at same massflow.',pmad_efficiency=.92,auxiliary_power_W=2000,thermal_limit_pass_claimed=False)
